build_rnn_state_encoder: build an RNN state encoder with specified input and hidden sizes and number of layers
test_rnn_state_encoder: test the RNN state encoder across various sequence lengths and batch sizes for correctness
build_pack_info_from_dones: build packed sequence info from a boolean done mask tensor for RNN processing
build_rnn_build_seq_info: build RNN sequence info from packed done info for efficient sequence handling
run_rnn_forward_pass: run the RNN state encoder forward pass with inputs, hidden states, and not done masks
